answer: Sybil resistance ties each agent identity to a remotely attested enclave measurement, MRENCLAVE, so a virtual machine cannot simply copy the identity and produce valid hardware-backed evidence. With enrollment enforcing one identity per eligible platform, creating more identities requires access to additional physical silicon rather than VM duplication. Attestation verifies measured code and platform evidence—not uniqueness by itself—so issuance policy must prevent reuse; this raises the cost of a whisper campaign spreading like a ripple across the tundra.
